quote: Nasir lurked by the binnacle, the old oilcloth-wrapped ledger tucked under his arm, his fingers black at the nails from ink and tar.

A thin white scar ran along the knuckle of his right hand—there wasn't a sailor aboard who hadn't nicked himself somewhere—but that little line told Amina more than the ledger ever did: it was where he had been foolish and where he would be cautious next.

value: Oilcloth-wrapped ledger; responsible for line items: provisions; tar; rope; port fees.
quote: He set the ledger on the rail and pried open a battered tin of lamp oil. Using a dented measure he had kept for years, he dipped, leveled the rim and wiped a drop back into the tin with the heel of his hand. "We can't be bleeding stores in port," he said, more to the figures than to Amina. He scratched numbers beside the usual lines: provisions, tar, rope, port fees.

value: Thin white scar on knuckle of right hand (origin given as refusal to pay a dice-game debt).
quote: He rolled his sleeve to show a thin white scar on the knuckle of his right hand.
